_readme: Site-wide facts. Edit a value here and run npm run build; every page updates. Leave a value empty until it is confirmed and the site shows a [CONFIRM] marker in its place.
missionLine: Mentors, real leadership, and a plan for life after high school for Rio Grande Valley teenagers, at no cost to their families.

analytics._readme: Paste a GA4 measurement ID (looks like G-XXXXXXX) to turn on Google Analytics. For a GoHighLevel pixel, paste its snippet into partials/analytics.html instead.
